spec.description: metrics for the data layer

spec.expr:
min by (physicalTenant, partition) (
  rate(zeebe_camunda_exporter_flush_latency_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]) / 
  rate(zeebe_camunda_exporter_flush_latency_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace",physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])
)

spec.description: How long an export request is open and collecting new records before flushing.
spec.title: Camunda Exporter (Flush Latency)

spec.expr:
sum(increase(zeebe_camunda_exporter_bulk_size_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])) by (physicalTenant, partition) / 
sum(increase(zeebe_camunda_exporter_bulk_size_count{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])) by (physicalTenant, partition)

spec.description: For every non empty flush of a bulk request, this is the number of entities flushed.
spec.title: Camunda Exporter (Bulk Size)

spec.description: Shows the rate of access to the process cache per partition
spec.title: Process cache access

spec.description: Shows the rate of evictions of the process cache
spec.title: Process cache eviction

spec.description: The time the cache spent computing or retrieving the new value
spec.title: Cache load duration

spec.description: The rate of the loading data into the cache
spec.title: Cache load rate

spec.description: Shows the rate of archiving (in-progress) and archived process instance and batch operations. Batch operations or process instances need to be completed before being able to be archived. The rate is aggregated by partition.
spec.title: Archiving

spec.description: Number of archiver batch retries caused by retryable errors (e.g. socket timeouts, search engine exceptions). Consecutive points overlap, so a single burst appears in several points. Sustained non-zero values indicate the search engine is struggling to keep up with archiving.
spec.title: Archiving - Batch retries

spec.expr: max by (source) (zeebe_camunda_exporter_archiver_index_duration_seconds_max{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"})

spec.description: Maximum duration of archiving a batch of documents, per source index.
spec.title: Archiving - Max duration

spec.description: Rate of documents archived, summed over all source indices.
spec.title: Archiving - Doc count

spec.description: Histogram to show the distribution of the overall archiving duration, which includes searching, reindexing, and deletion.
spec.title: Archiving duration

spec.description: Historgram, to show the distribution of the duration of search requests to find completed entities, which should be archived.
spec.title: Archiving - Search request duration

spec.description: Historgram, to show the distribution of durations reindex requests take, to copy data from runtime to dated indices.
spec.title: Archiving - Reindex request duration

spec.description: Each time a non empty bulk request if flushed, this is how long the flush takes.
spec.title: Elasticsearch Exporter (Flush Duration)

spec.description: Historgram, to show the distribution of durations delete requests take, to delete data from runtime indices.
spec.title: Archiving - Delete request duration

spec.expr: rate(zeebe_rdbms_exporter_flush_latency_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(zeebe_rdbms_exporter_flush_latency_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0

spec.description: How long an export request is open and collecting new records before flushing.
spec.title: RDBMS Exporter (Flush Latency)

spec.expr: rate(zeebe_rdbms_exporter_failed_flush_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(zeebe_rdbms_exporter_flush_duration_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])

spec.description: The rate of failure of flush operations, averaged over 15s intervals
spec.title: RDBMS Exporter (Flush Failure Rate)
RDBMS Exporter JDBC Statements Batch factor

spec.expr: rate(zeebe_elasticsearch_exporter_failed_flush_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(zeebe_elasticsearch_exporter_flush_duration_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])

spec.description: The rate of failure of flush operations, averaged over 15s intervals
spec.title: Elasticsearch Exporter (Flush Failure Rate)

spec.description: Throughput of documents processed and imported.
spec.title: Throughput Exported and Imported records (avg)

spec.description: Shows the time (latency) between writing the command to the dispatcher, processing, exporting, and then importing the record.
spec.title: Latency (avg)

spec.description: The time it takes for the importer to read an record on average from ES
spec.title: Importing: read duration

spec.description: Time the import writer thread needs on average to process an ImportBatch (containing several Zeebe records).
spec.title: Import processing duration (AVG)

spec.description: The time it takes to write the bulk requests (during importing) to ES on average.
spec.title: Importing: write duration (avg)

spec.description: There is a queue of import jobs where each job has to import a batch of records. This details how many such jobs are currently in the queue.
spec.title: Import queue size

spec.description: For every non empty flush of a bulk request, this is the number of entities flushed.
spec.title: Elasticsearch Exporter (Bulk Size)

spec.description: When bulk request flushes fail, the type of error returned is counted.
spec.title: Camunda Exporter (Flush Failure Type)

spec.expr: min by (physicalTenant, partition) (zeebe_camunda_exporter_since_last_flush_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"})

spec.description: The time in seconds since the last flush.
spec.title: Camunda Exporter (Time since last flush)

spec.expr: max (zeebe_log_appender_last_committed_position{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}) by (physicalTenant, partition) - max (zeebe_exporter_last_exported_position{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", exporter=~"(?i)camundaexporter"}) by (physicalTenant, partition)

spec.description: How far behind each exporter is from exporting the records which have been committed.
spec.title: Camunda Exporter (Records to export backlog)

spec.expr: max by (physicalTenant, partition) (zeebe_camunda_exporter_process_instances_awaiting_archival{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"})

spec.description: Process instances which can be archived but are waiting to do so.
spec.title: Camunda Exporter (Process Instances Awaiting Archival)

spec.expr: max by (physicalTenant, partition) (zeebe_camunda_exporter_incident_updates_pending{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"})

spec.description: Incidents that have not yet been processed by the update task.
spec.title: Camunda Exporter (Pending incident updates)

spec.expr: rate(zeebe_rdbms_exporter_queue_memory_bytes_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(zeebe_rdbms_exporter_queue_memory_bytes_count{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])

spec.description: Each bulk request has a number of records, the memory usage to flush this bulk request is crudely measured through content length and tracked here.
spec.title: Elasticsearch Exporter (Bulk Memory Size)

spec.description: Time taken to init secondary storage schema.
spec.title: $namespace

spec.description: HikariCP client-pool connections opened by each Camunda pod towards Postgres (or PgBouncer, if enabled), per physical tenant.
spec.title: HikariCP Connections (Active/Idle, by node)

spec.expr:
sum(hikaricp_connections_active{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant"}) by (pod, physicalTenant)
/
sum(hikaricp_connections_max{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant"}) by (pod, physicalTenant)

spec.description: HikariCP pool utilization per Camunda pod (active connections ÷ configured maximum pool size).
spec.title: HikariCP Pool Utilization

spec.description: PgBouncer client-side pool (Camunda pods → PgBouncer), by Postgres database/user. cl_active = linked to a server; cl_waiting = queued for one (backpressure signal). Only populated when the CNPG Pooler is enabled. No per-pod breakdown is available here: PgBouncer's transaction pooling severs the 1:1 client-to-server mapping, so node attribution lives on the HikariCP panel above instead.
spec.title: PgBouncer Client Pool (Active/Waiting)

spec.description: PgBouncer server-side pool (PgBouncer → Postgres), by database/user — the real number of backend connections the pool is holding open. sv_used connections were used but are not yet reset/returned to the pool.
spec.title: PgBouncer Server Pool (Active/Idle/Used)

spec.description: Real PostgreSQL backend connections, by state, from the CNPG Cluster's own metrics — the authoritative count regardless of whether PgBouncer is in front of it.
spec.title: Postgres Backend Connections (by state)

spec.description: Total Postgres backend connections ÷ max_connections. Useful whether or not PgBouncer is in front of the cluster.
spec.title: Postgres Connections Utilization

spec.description: Count of physical tenants whose secondary storage is ready (ready on every currently-scraped node) versus the total known physical tenants. A gap between the two lines, or Total dropping, needs investigation via the per-tenant panel below.
spec.title: Physical Tenant Readiness (Ready vs Total)

spec.description: Per-physical-tenant secondary storage readiness: worst case (min) across currently-scraped nodes. A tenant not scraped within Prometheus' staleness window (5m) drops out of this panel entirely rather than showing red; check the panel above and node liveness in that case.
spec.title: Physical Tenant Readiness (per tenant)

spec.description: CPU usage per ES/OpenSearch and Zeebe/orchestration pod, to correlate with CPU throttling above.
spec.title: ES & Zeebe CPU usage

spec.expr: sum by (pod) (max by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~".*(orchestration|zeebe|camunda|elastic|opensearch).*", container!~"", resource="memory"}))

sum by (pod) (max by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~".*(orchestration|zeebe|camunda|elastic|opensearch).*", container!~"", resource="memory"}))

spec.description: Memory limit, request and actual usage per ES/OpenSearch and Zeebe/orchestration pod, to correlate resource pressure with CPU throttling above.
spec.title: ES & Zeebe Memory Limit/Request/Usage

spec.description: Disk read/write throughput per ES/OpenSearch and Zeebe/orchestration pod, to correlate I/O pressure with CPU throttling above.
spec.title: ES & Zeebe Disk I/O

spec.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", container!~"", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~".*(orchestration|zeebe|camunda|elastic|opensearch).*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod) (max by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~".*(orchestration|zeebe|camunda|elastic|opensearch).*", container!~"", resource="cpu"}))

spec.description: CPU usage as a fraction of the CPU request, per ES/OpenSearch and Zeebe/orchestration pod. Sustained values near/above 1 point to genuine undersizing rather than a transient burst.
spec.title: ES & Zeebe CPU usage vs request

spec.description: Rate of ES operations per index: refresh, merge, indexing, delete, flush, get, search fetch/query/scroll/suggest. Correlate spikes here with CPU throttling to see whether it's driven by actual workload.
spec.title: ES Activity by operations

spec.description: Accumulated ES JVM garbage collection time by GC type, over the selected interval. A high, rising value is a common non-workload cause of CPU throttling.
spec.title: ES GC duration

spec.description: ES thread pool active thread count vs rejection rate. Rejections indicate the pool is saturated, not just a CPU blip.
spec.title: ES Thread Pools vs Rejections

spec.description: Lucene segment count. High segment counts drive more merging (CPU-heavy).
spec.title: ES Lucene Segments

spec.expr: sum(rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~".*(orchestration|zeebe|camunda|elastic|opensearch).*", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod) / sum(rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~".*(orchestration|zeebe|camunda|elastic|opensearch).*", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod)

spec.description:
The average percentage of CPU periods where the container ran but was throttled (stopped from running the whole CPU period), for ES/OpenSearch and Zeebe/orchestration pods. Correlate spikes here with archiver backlog and duration panels above.

container_cpu_cfs_periods_total - Number of elapsed enforcement period intervals
container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total - Number of throttled period intervals

https://github.com/google/cadvisor/blob/master/docs/storage/prometheus.md
spec.title: ES & Zeebe CPU Throttling (AVG)

spec.title: Camunda Exporter (Flush Duration)

spec.description: The rate of failure of flush operations, averaged over 15s intervals
spec.title: Camunda Exporter (Flush Failure Rate)
